dexterous prayer scroll._note: Unlocks the Rigour prayer. Consumed on reading, not equipable, but a genuine (and very valuable) CoX unique reward.

arcane prayer scroll._note: Unlocks the Augury prayer. Same as the Dexterous scroll - consumed on reading.

bandos hilt._note: Not equipable itself - combines with a bought Godsword blade to make the Bandos godsword - but worth 500k+ and a genuine chase drop, so it counts on its own.

godsword shard 1._note: Drops from any of the 4 GWD generals/sub-bosses, not one specific boss. Combines with shards 2 and 3 into a Godsword blade.

serpentine visage._note: The actual drop - becomes Serpentine helm with a chisel. Zulrah never drops the finished helm.

tanzanite fang._note: The actual drop - becomes Toxic blowpipe with a chisel. Zulrah never drops the finished blowpipe.

magic fang._note: Combines with a Staff of the Dead or uncharged Trident of the seas to make the Toxic staff of the dead / Trident of the swamp. Not a trophy - corrected after being wrongly excluded earlier.

primordial crystal._note: The actual drop - becomes Primordial boots when combined with Dragon boots. Cerberus never drops the finished boots.

pegasian crystal._note: Becomes Pegasian boots when combined with Ranger boots.

eternal crystal._note: Becomes Eternal boots when combined with Infinity boots.

imbued heart._note: Not equipable (it's activated, not worn) and not tied to one specific boss - drops from any 'superior' Slayer monster spawn. Still a genuinely rare (500k+) shared item, so it counts.

smouldering stone._note: Upgrades a Dragon axe/harpoon/pickaxe into its Infernal variant. Also drops (much more rarely) from ordinary hellhounds, but Cerberus is its real, notable source.

tormented synapse._note: Used to create demonbane weapons (Emberlight, Purging staff, Scorching bow).

burning claw._note: Two combine into the finished Burning claws weapon.

zenyte shard._note: Crafted into Cut zenyte, then Zenyte jewelry (blood fury, anguish, torture, suffering).

granite hammer._note: Doubles as a rock hammer and a weapon - PvM tool, shared/borrowed within a group.

hydra's claw._note: The actual drop - becomes Dragon hunter lance when combined with a Zamorakian hasta. Hydra never drops the finished lance.

hydra's eye._note: One of 3 pieces (with fang and heart) that combine into Brimstone ring - Hydra never drops the ring itself.

hydra leather._note: Makes Ferocious gloves at the Lithkren Vault machinery. Not a dead-end material - corrected after being wrongly excluded earlier.

voidwaker hilt._note: 1 of 3 Voidwaker pieces (hilt/blade/gem) - each drops from a different wilderness boss pair and must be combined at Ferox Enclave. No boss drops the finished Voidwaker.

dragon pickaxe._note: PvM tool, not just combat gear - genuinely shared/borrowed within a group for mining, unlike a spare weapon or armour piece.

dragon harpoon._note: Not tied to one specific named boss the way the other entries are (its real source is Wyrms, a mid-tier slayer monster) - included anyway since it's still a rare, shareable PvM tool.

broken zombie axe._note: The actual drop - repaired into the finished Zombie axe at an anvil with 70 Smithing. Armoured zombies never drop the finished axe directly.

fangs of venenatis._note: Combines with a separately-obtained Craw's bow to make Webweaver bow.

elysian sigil._note: The actual drop - combines with a separately-obtained base Spirit shield to make the finished shield. Corporeal Beast never drops the finished Elysian/Arcane/Spectral shield directly.

nihil horn._note: Upgrades an Armadyl crossbow into a Zaryte crossbow (with 250 nihil shards). Not a dead-end material - corrected after being wrongly excluded earlier.

executioner's axe head._note: 1 of 4 Soulreaper axe components (one per DT2 boss) combined at The Overseer. No DT2 boss drops the finished axe.

magus vestige._note: The actual drop - becomes Magus ring via Crafting with a seers icon, chromium ingots, and a ring mould. Duke Sucellus never drops the finished ring.

araxyte fang._note: Combines with an Amulet of torture to make Amulet of rancour - Araxxor never drops the finished amulet.

noxious pommel._note: 1 of 3 Noxious halberd components. Araxxor never drops the finished halberd.

mokhaiotl cloth._note: Used with demon tears to upgrade Oathplate armour - counted since it's a genuine Doom-specific rare drop, not a common byproduct.

crystal armour seed._note: Can't be scoped to Corrupted Gauntlet only - same item name from either mode.

bludgeon axon._note: 1 of 3 Abyssal bludgeon components combined by The Overseer. Abyssal Sire never drops the finished bludgeon.

unsired._note: Guaranteed common byproduct, not a rare unique on its own

giantsoul amulet.source: Branda the Fire Queen/Eldric the Ice King

echo crystal._note: Used on Guardian boots to make Echo boots (extra prayer bonus + recoil charges).
